name: design
description: Portable design craft and evidence-based ultrareview — grounds UI in semantic tokens + a known component substrate (shadcn/Tailwind/lucide), rejects the looks AI defaults to, and spends motion deliberately. Human-directed planning separates discovery from implementation, making intent, trade-offs, approval, and rendered evidence visible. Reads a per-repo BRAND.md for brand-specific tokens. `generate`/`apply` derive and enforce that brand automatically, while read-only `review` evaluates hierarchy, states, accessibility, responsiveness, motion, and performance from rendered evidence.
